profile.headline: Software Engineer -​> IT Project Manager | Delivery Lead | Java/AWS | Agile & Risk Management
profile.summary: Software Engineer and de facto delivery lead with 5+ years in financial services, combining hands-on Java/AWS engineering with end-to-end project leadership. Currently leading project planning for a platform-as-a-service monitoring product — from requirements through Operational Readiness Testing — while serving as Subject Matter Expert. Experienced in stakeholder coordination, risk management, and Agile delivery, with a Java/Spring Boot/AWS technical foundation. Working toward CAPM certification to formalize a transition into IT Project Management / Delivery Lead roles.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Authored detailed project plans and broke down 60+ stories spanning the full delivery lifecycle for Watchdog, a web-based monitoring platform-as-a-service, from initial requirements through Operational Readiness Testing (ORT); managing sprint planning and backlog grooming in Jira.

Coordinate delivery across four distinct stakeholder groups — internal engineering, leadership, an external client, and front-line operations/user teams — resolving misalignments and reconciling conflicting priorities into a single actionable plan.

Identify, track, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies throughout the delivery lifecycle, advocating for realistic, risk-adjusted timelines.

Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for 2 of the team's 7 core monitoring products, providing planning and operational continuity through a year of significant team turnover.

positions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
Build full-stack applications using Java/SpringBoot for backend services and Angular/React for frontends
● Build RESTful API backends using JPA/Hibernate to connect to MySQL Databases
● Store, scan, and deploy artifacts through CI/CD pipelines through the use Jenkins, Coverity, and Nexus Repositories 
● Use Docker and AWS Cloudformation/Terraform, EC2, ALB, VPC for deployment
● Integrate Swagger/OpenAPI for documentation in backend services and write tests for the front end

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Use Learning and Development resources such as provided curriculum materials and repositories to provide instruction to students.
Attend Demo days and events to provide insightful feedback on presentation and support student learning
Collaborate with other instructional staff members to streamline and improve target efforts
Share personal experiences of learning and growth as an instructor to students

positions.title: Assistant Instructor
positions.description:
Assist during instructional time by maintaining Zoom call breakout rooms, taking attendance, uploading coursework and answering questions through chat
Provide support to students during office hours by helping them resolve their challenges, encouraging them to take a hands on approach in both individual and group settings
Coordinate with other Assistant Instructors on roles and duties in case of the Instructors absence

positions.title: Code Tutor
positions.description:
● Collaborate effectively with students and the education team to increase student performance
● Facilitate problem-solving with a curious mind and critical thinking skills.
● Design differentiated and personalized learning goals and activities that follow a coherent sequence
● Debug student code and lead student to correct errors while learning to research and code

positions.title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Liaison with clients from all over the world and facilitate the transition to a new ERP 
Processed purchase orders over $100,000, initiate teams to move forward with the production of custom made orders.
Assisted in training and meeting notes for the transition of ERP systems
Worked in teams to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies  
Centralized notes and documentation for clients' purchase orders, speeding up our ability to respond to clients swiftly.

positions.title: Document Clerk
positions.description:
• Schedule and maintain conference rooms. 
• Provide callers with information such as firm address, directions to the firm location, firm fax numbers, firm website and other related information. 
• Create Client Packets 
• Print Consult Notifications and prepare Consult Intake forms 
• Scan Client Intake documents and save to network drive 
• Prepare and send documents to Client Services via email in a timely manner 
• Update Consult Time Log throughout the day 
• Receive, sort, and forward incoming mail. 
• Coordinate the pick-up and delivery of express mail services (FedEx, UPS, etc.) 
• Assist in the ordering, receiving, stocking and distribution of office supplies. 
• Assist with other related clerical duties such as photocopying, faxing, filing and collating.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•Format letters and contracts and send to their respective clients, create transmittals for official company documents
•Host and organize client open house for 2 consecutive years for 100+ people, generate guest list, communicate between property management, catering, security and entertainment. 
•Code several macros for different documents for automation; increased the efficiency of the other engineers
•Plan and remodel both large and small conference areas, reception, and engineers desks.
•Create expense reports for Principal Engineers and maintain up-to-date information on budgets and current invoices for all open projects
•Team with HR, payroll, A/R, and A/P to keep employees, clients and corporate level figures informed of project updates
•Coordinate travel plans and schedules; internationally and domestically

positions.title: Temporary Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•Schedule appointments and answer questions about scheduling for clients and counselors using Pro-filer, through phone and in person   
•Assemble and organize orientation packets, warmly welcome and direct clients to correct destination in a fast and stressful environment
•Notify counselors of clients' arrival through email and phone, alert detox nurses for detox check in
•Use a multi-line phone to answer and transfer clients calls, reach out to clients to make appointments, and make reminder calls
•Close at end of day: submit daily reports, balance cash, prepare for next day, lock the executive hall, light housekeeping in breakrooms and office

positions.title: Front Desk Agent
positions.description:
•	Answer Inquiries regarding hotel services and registration by telephone and in person, provide information about services available in the area and respond to guests’ complaints
•	Compile and check daily record sheets, guest accounts, and receipts using computerized or manual systems
•	Maintain an inventory of vacancies, reservations, and room assignments
•	Register arriving guests and assign rooms, gather personal and card information
•	Take messages through a multi-line phone and fax, route calls to specific rooms
•	Ensure cleanliness of lobby and facilities and closing when it is time
•	Monitor and maintain office equipment  and resupplying
